text_block_list.text: One day, while passing near the gymnasium—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight, here we go!! "Trinity 
Posing"!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Knees! Elbows! Shoulders! Knees! Elbows! 
Shoulders!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Knees!! Elbows!! Shoulders!! 
TRINITYYYY!!!!"

Gold Ship strikes some kind of pose. 
Looking closely, her knees, elbows, and 
shoulders are all bent at perfect right 
angles...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Phew! Did we pull it off?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! Man, if you were here, you 
should've said something~.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So, how was it? My "Knees, Elbows, and 
Shoulders: The Trinity Pose"?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Right? Keeping your knees, elbows, and 
shoulders all at right angles is 
surprisingly tough work.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I've been practicin' something I 
wanna try out at the next Winning Live—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It still doesn't feel quite right to me. 
What d'ya think I'm missin'?

Even while wondering if they really 
intended to do this during the Winning 
Live—
choice_data_list:
You should give it more of everything 
you've got.

You should try holding it for a longer 
time.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hoh... So even if you think you're giving 
it your all, it doesn't always come across 
to the audience, huh...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, then this time I'm going all out 
enough to snap those emotional 
heartstrings! Here I come!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Kneeeeees!! Elbowwws!! 
Shouldeeeeeerrrrrrrs!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: TRI! NI! TYYYYYY AAAAAAACCCCCTTTTT!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*... *gasp*... *gasp*......

According to what I heard later, Gold 
Ship's full-throated shout was loud enough 
to echo outside the academy grounds.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Holding such a grueling posture for that 
long...?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
“Still, moving the crowd with your sheer 
effort is what makes someone a true 
entertainer, y'know?”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Let's do this, then. ...Make 
sure you watch over me closely.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Tri... Ni... Ty... AAAACTTTT!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: THIS IS...!! MY... WAY OF LIFE...!!!!

Gold Ship held her pose for thirty 
straight minutes. Watching her work so 
hard... made me feel weirdly encouraged.
